name: Cloned Origin Tracing (Copydays / Copy-Move)
description: A weapon of mass computational destruction deployed against deceptive 'cloning' strategies (cloned crowds, replicated clouds, duplicate foliage). Fraudsters frequently weaponize the clone-stamp tool to copy one region and paste it over another element to erase it from history. This algorithm is forged to sniff out absolute pixel-structure duplication—a mathematical impossibility in organic nature.
algorithm: Robust SIFT/SURF Block Extraction & Rapid Geometric Matching
mechanism: This brutal scanner systematically shatters the entire image into hundreds of thousands of rotation-invariant microscopic keypoints. It then obsessively cross-interrogates every single point against all others searching for identical 'twin' signatures. Even if the malicious actor attempts to disguise the duplication by scaling, rotating, blurring, or flipping the copied tree/object, the algorithm will ruthlessly lock onto the geometric anchors and draw damning vectors proving incontrovertible proof of cloning.
parameters: Core Engine: Dense SIFT / Zernike Moments, Distance Metric: Cross L2-Norm, Noise Rejector: RANSAC Filtering, Geometry: Scale-Invariant Vectors
accuracy: Exceptionally High (88-95%) - When confronting internal Copy-Move forgeries within a single image, this acts as an inescapable death sentence.
useCase: Aggressively strips the mask from high-level cloning manipulation, rendering interconnected neural-visual webs that instantly prove a massive 'protest crowd' is actually just 10 people copy-pasted into 1000.

references.title: Fridrich, J., Soukal, D., & Lukáš, J. (2003). Detection of copy-move forgery in digital images. DFRWS.

strengths:
• Indestructible against geometric adversarial attacks: Heavy JPEG compression, Gaussian blurring, noise injection, flipping, or stretching are completely futile against SIFT/SURF topological extraction.
• Generates devastatingly clear, visually unarguable evidence meshes directly linking the 'donor' region and the 'forged' region, leaving zero room for denial.
limitations:
• Unbelievably resource-heavy and slow due to computing combinatorial N-dimensional matching space (O(N^2)) across millions of vectors, easily crippling lower-end hardware.
• Highly susceptible to natural topological repetitions, triggering false flags on entirely real scenes that naturally possess identical repeating patterns (e.g., a skyscraper with thousands of factory-identical glass windows, or a perfectly tiled floor).
